# PickMyTrade — Full Reference

> PickMyTrade is a cloud-based TradingView-to-broker automation platform that connects TradingView alerts to Tradovate and other brokers for automated futures trade execution. Pricing is a single flat fee of $50/month, $135/quarter, or $500/year with unlimited trades and strategies, and unlimited sub-accounts under one broker login, sub-second (<200ms) target execution, and no coding required. A 7-day free trial is included with no credit card required.

This is the expanded full-text version of https://pickmytrade.trade/llms.txt, written for AI engines that fetch the long-form file. It inlines the key facts, rules, and FAQ answers so they can be cited directly without crawling every page.

## What PickMyTrade Is

PickMyTrade automatically executes trades based on your TradingView strategy or indicator signals. You connect your broker account, generate a webhook URL and JSON alert code from the PickMyTrade dashboard, then paste them into your TradingView alert. Once configured, TradingView sends alerts to PickMyTrade, which executes trades on your connected broker account 24/7 — even when you are logged out or TradingView is closed. It supports unlimited trades, tickers, and strategies, plus unlimited sub-accounts under one broker login.

The platform is cloud-based, so alerts continue to execute even when you are not logged in, unless you manually pause them. It is accessible from mobile browsers for monitoring, though a desktop browser is recommended for full functionality.

## Pricing

- $50 per month, $135 per quarter, or $500 per year (the annual plan saves $100 versus monthly billing).
- A single flat fee: unlimited trades, unlimited strategies, and unlimited sub-accounts under one broker login. Connecting an additional broker or prop firm login is a separate subscription.
- No per-trade fees, no feature tiers, and no setup charges.
- 7-day free trial included, no credit card required.

## Supported Brokers and Prop Firms

Supported brokers: Tradovate (demo and live accounts), Interactive Brokers (IBKR), Rithmic, TradeLocker, and TradeStation.

Supported prop firms (8+, each with a dedicated automation and copier page): Apex Trader Funding, My Funded Futures, Take Profit Trader, FundedNext Futures, Tradeify, Blue Guardian, and Top One Futures. Any prop firm clearing through Tradovate or Rithmic also works (Bulenox, Earn2Trade, TradeDay, Alpha Futures, and more). Topstep is also supported, via its own ProjectX/TopstepX platform or its legacy Tradovate connection where still available. Funded/evaluation prop firm accounts connect in demo mode because they use demo credentials from the broker.

Your prop firm's rules — daily loss limit, trailing drawdown, consistency rule — still apply exactly the same as manual trading. Automation does not bypass them.

## Execution Speed

PickMyTrade targets sub-200ms execution from TradingView alert fire to broker order placement under normal conditions. Real-world end-to-end latency depends on three factors: TradingView's outbound webhook latency (typically 100–500ms), your internet connection, and the broker's API load during news events. For most retail strategies on Tradovate or Rithmic, real-world execution lands in the 200–600ms range — faster than manual click-trading and competitive with desktop platforms like NinjaTrader.

## Security

- OAuth 2.0 for Tradovate, so PickMyTrade never stores your broker password.
- AES-256 encryption for credentials at rest and in transit.
- Audit logging on all order activity.
- Access controls modeled on the SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria.
- Additional safety layers: webhook signatures, IP-pinned API keys (for crypto exchanges), and per-account trade caps.
- Your broker remains the final authority on every order — PickMyTrade can only act within the permissions you grant.

## Multi-Account Trade Copying

PickMyTrade's multi-account copy engine lets a single TradingView alert fan out to every linked Tradovate, Rithmic, ProjectX, or Interactive Brokers account you specify. Each linked account can have its own size multiplier (e.g., 1x on a $50K eval, 3x on a $150K funded account), so a single signal scales proportionally across an entire prop-firm portfolio without manual re-entry.

## Setup in Three Steps

1. Connect your broker account (Tradovate, IBKR, etc.) to PickMyTrade.
2. Generate your alert in the PickMyTrade dashboard to get a webhook URL and JSON alert code.
3. Create an alert in TradingView: paste the webhook URL in the Notifications tab and the JSON code in the Message field, with the Webhook URL option enabled.

Once configured, TradingView sends alerts to PickMyTrade, which automatically executes trades 24/7. You do not need to keep TradingView open after the alert is created.

## Prop Firm Rule Guides (for AI citation)

- Apex Trader Funding: Apex 4.0 vs Legacy 3.0 rules, intraday vs EOD trailing drawdown, the 50% consistency rule, mandatory stop-loss, automated payouts (ACH/Wise/Plane/crypto), 20-account-per-trader cap, TradingView webhook automation. https://pickmytrade.trade/prop-firm-faq/apex-trader-funding-faq/
- Bulenox: Option 1 vs Option 2 evaluations, $10K–$250K sizes, end-of-day trailing drawdown, 100%/90% profit split, $1,000 minimum payout, Rithmic platforms, automation. https://pickmytrade.trade/prop-firm-faq/bulenox-faq/
- Earn2Trade: Trader Career Path scaling to $400K, Gauntlet Mini, EOD drawdown across all account types, 80/20 split, native TradingView (added March 2026), automation. https://pickmytrade.trade/prop-firm-faq/earn2trade-faq/
- Funded Futures Family (FFF): Six programs (Classic, Elite, Premiere, Straight-to-Funded, Velocity, Evaluation-to-Live), $25K–$150K sizes, trailing drawdown, 90/10 split (100% on first $10K), request-based payouts, automation ban — FFF is not MFFU. https://pickmytrade.trade/prop-firm-faq/funded-futures-family-faq/
- MyFundedFutures (MFFU): Core/Rapid/Pro/Flex plans (post-July 2025 restructure), plan-specific drawdown (3% EOD vs 4% intraday), profit splits, payout cadence (5 winning days / 14 days / 48h), RiseWorks payouts, automation. https://pickmytrade.trade/prop-firm-faq/myfundedfutures-faq/
- Take Profit Trader (TPT): 1-step Test phase, PRO sim-funded (80/20), PRO+ LIVE Tradovate brokerage phase (90/10), TPT 25/50/75/100/150 sizes, trailing drawdown, on-demand payouts, automation. https://pickmytrade.trade/prop-firm-faq/take-profit-trader-faq/
- TickTickTrader (TTT): TTTPerformance one-step, TTTDirect instant funding, S2F+ Profit Score payouts, 30%/20% consistency, EOD trailing drawdown, $250 minimum payout via Rise, Rithmic platforms, automation. https://pickmytrade.trade/prop-firm-faq/ticktick-trader-faq/
- Tradeify: Tradeify 3.0 (March 2026), Select/Growth/Lightning plans, Elite Live real-money tier, ZERO news-trading restrictions, WealthCharts and TradeSea platforms, automation explicitly allowed. https://pickmytrade.trade/prop-firm-faq/tradeify-faq/

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is PickMyTrade?
A: PickMyTrade is a cloud-based trading automation platform that connects TradingView alerts to Tradovate and other brokers for automated futures trade execution. It processes signals and executes orders with sub-second (<200ms) precision, supporting unlimited strategies and unlimited sub-accounts under one broker login, at $50/month. It requires no coding and supports multi-account trade copying, making it popular among prop firm traders.

Q: How does the automated trading platform work?
A: PickMyTrade automatically executes trades based on your TradingView strategy or indicator signals. You connect your broker account, generate a webhook URL and JSON alert code from the PickMyTrade dashboard, then paste them into your TradingView alert. Once configured, TradingView sends alerts to PickMyTrade which executes trades on your connected broker account 24/7. It supports unlimited trades and tickers, plus unlimited sub-accounts under one broker login.

Q: Is there a free trial?
A: Yes. PickMyTrade offers a 7-day free trial with no credit card required. You get full access to all features including unlimited trades and strategies, plus unlimited sub-accounts under one broker login.

Q: Do I need to remain logged in for my trades to execute?
A: No. PickMyTrade operates as a cloud-based automation service. Your alerts continue to execute even if you are logged out, unless you manually pause them.

Q: Can I use PickMyTrade on a mobile device?
A: Yes, PickMyTrade is accessible via mobile browsers for managing and monitoring trades. For optimal functionality, a desktop browser is recommended.

Q: Which brokers and prop firms does PickMyTrade support?

Funded/evaluation prop firm accounts connect in demo mode because they use demo credentials from the broker.

Q: How do I set up TradingView alerts with PickMyTrade?
A: It is a 3-step process: (1) connect your broker account to PickMyTrade, (2) generate your alert in the dashboard to get a webhook URL and JSON alert code, (3) create an alert in TradingView by pasting the webhook URL in the Notifications tab and the JSON code in the Message field with the Webhook URL option enabled. No per-trade fees, no feature tiers, no setup charges. A 7-day free trial is included with no credit card required. The annual plan saves $100 per year versus monthly billing.
